note: Coarse numbers measured from the Red Alert 2 sounds that the rules name, by tools/standalone-audio/MeasureAudio.cs (decoded in memory by the engine; no samples were written). The replacements in mods/rtsai/standalone/audio match their role, length and loudness; nothing else is taken from them. Fields: seconds, rate, peak/rms/active_rms dBFS, onset/attack/decay20 ms (10 ms RMS envelope; decay20 = time from the loudest window to the last window within -20 dB), zcr_hz (zero crossings/2 per second), low_share (<250 Hz one-pole) and high_share (>2.5 kHz one-pole) of the signal energy.
